In other words, when Leidos revises EAC (or variable consideration estimates), it “catches up” revenue and profit based on what results would have been if the updated estimate had been used since contract inception. In the periods shown, these estimate changes produced a **net favorable impact to income before taxes** of **$40M (2023), $33M (2022), and $47M (2021)**, and impacted diluted EPS by **$0.22, $0.17, and $0.25**, respectively. - **Variable consideration and prior-period performance obligations:** Some contracts include award/incentive fees or other variable consideration that can increase or decrease the transaction price.
